_comment: Template for a single Hermes tool/function definition. Paste into the <tools> block in your system prompt. Remove _comment fields before use.

function.name: function_name
function._comment_name: snake_case, no spaces. Used verbatim in <tool_call> output.
function.description: One or two sentences describing what this function does and when to use it. Be specific about inputs and outputs.

required_string_param.description: What this parameter represents. Include format hints if non-obvious (e.g. 'ISO 8601 date string like 2024-01-15').

required_enum_param.description: Must be one of the listed values.

optional_array_param.description: Optional list of strings. Leave empty to return all results.

nested_field.description: A nested field within the object.

optional_boolean_param.description: Optional. Set to true to enable verbose output. Defaults to false.

parameters._comment_required: List only truly required params. Optional params reduce model call errors.
